text.en: India has a rich heritage of games and physical activity: wrestling, malkhamb, kalaripayattu, thang-ta, gatka and archery. Unit 2 of the book has 12 group games.

India recognised long ago that a healthy body and mind are part of education. The book names wrestling, malkhamb, kalaripayattu, thang-ta, gatka and archery as parts of this heritage.
Unit 2, Our Games, has 12 group games, some new and some local and traditional. Each game has material, how to play, a purpose, variations and a circle-time talk.
These games teach teamwork, following rules, accepting wins and losses gracefully and being kind to each other.
The book also suggests exploring games from your own area and asking elders, parents and grandparents about the games they played.
Note: the pages of this chapter are pictures in the book file, so the individual rules of each game are not covered here. Please read the games in your textbook with your teacher.
